background_story: Ivan was a skilled sailor who spent his life navigating the open waters. Born in the coastal town of Plymouth, England, he grew up with the sea in his blood. As a young man, Ivan joined the crew of a historic replica ship, the Mayflower II, which sailed from Plymouth to America, retracing the famous 1620 voyage. Ivan's love for the sea and his hometown of Plymouth led him to become a maritime historian, specializing in the Pilgrims' journey. He spent years researching and writing about the brave men and women who set sail from Plymouth, seeking a new life in the New World. Ivan's passion for Plymouth's rich history earned him recognition as a leading expert in the field, and he was often called upon to give lectures and tours in his beloved hometown.
